name: Buckler Bash (Combat)
body:
You have learned to use your buckler as an effective weapon.

Prerequisites: Shield proficiency, at least one maneuver known from the Iron Tortoise or Broken Blade disciplines.

Benefit: You may make shield bash attacks with a buckler as though it was a light shield. You treat your buckler as an associated weapon for the Iron Tortoise and Broken Blade disciplines and may substitute a buckler bash for an unarmed strike if a maneuver calls for one.
